answer: The grindstone sprays sparks in the cutler's shop, and the blades lie in a row to cool. Proof of cutler via blade grind tally — a blade the cutler grinds only after 37 blades hold keen at the edge, each blade ground by the cutler himself. quartz holds each blade to the wheel, keeping the edge true. kernel hones the edge on the strop till it shaves a hair. horizon tests the temper by bending the blade and watching it spring back. Forging this tally takes 37 blades ground without a flaw, and the thirty-eighth still chips at the tip.
